questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: At forbedre mine franskkundskaber.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Paris har været fantastisk, men Panthéon-Sorbonne og undervisningen kan ikke anbefales.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Meget svært. Jeg var usikker på, om jeg overhovedet kom af sted op til 2 måneder før studiestart, fordi jeg aldrig fik svar fra universitetet på trods af utallige mails og mislykkedes telefonopkald, hvor der blot blev lagt på eller henvist til en anden person, som heller ikke kunne hjælpe.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Ingen. Man skulle finde ud af det hele selv. Heldigvis var det fint at finde ud af, så snart man var ankommet til Paris. Historien var noget anderledes, inden man ankom.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Har allerede benævnt.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Jeg boede i Cité Universitaire. Søgte om at bo i det danske studenterhus og blev optaget.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Der er en kantine i hovedbygningen, hvor de sælger billig frokost og aftensmad. I husene er der også køkken til selv at lave mad.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Man kan blive udvekslet til andre studenterhuse. F.eks. boede jeg i det belgiske, hvilket var okay rent værelsesmæssigt, men ikke super fedt mht. fællesarealer.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det er et billigt sted at bo

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Har allerede nævnt

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man fandt fagene inde på hjemmesiden, og så valgte jeg blot de fag, der havde engelsk titel uden at vide mere om det. Jeg blev automatisk registreret til de fag, der stod i min learning agreement. Det var super besværligt at skulle ændre sine fag, og af den grund beholdt jeg blot de fag, jeg i forvejen havde søgt forhåndgodkendelse til. Igen var der ingen information tilgængelig.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Ikke rigtig nogen

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik de fag, jeg havde udset mig til at starte med, men ville egentlig gerne have skiftet fag, da jeg ankom, men orkede ikke, da jeg vidste, at det ville være besværligt.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Lad være med at bekymre dig meget, hvis du ikke får meget information. Det kommer til at lykkedes på en eller anden måde, selvom det godt kan være lidt besværligt.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Man skal ikke gøre det for det faglige udbytte.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Fagene var meget nemme og det samme var eksaminerne (2 timers håndskrevet eksamen i hånden uden hjælpemidler). Det er et helt andet niveau end i København.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Udvekslingsstuderende følger kun forelæsninger, så det var også det, der påvirkede kvaliteten negativt. Ofte læste forelæsere blot op fra et papir, og det var svært at høre, hvad der blev sagt.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Comparative European Politics, Introduction to Post-Socialist Europe og Critical Approaches in Political Science

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Introduction to Post-Socialist Europe var det eneste interessante engelske fag. Har hørt bedre om nogle af de franske fag.

Housing DKK per month *

Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Det er meget dyrere at handle ind end forventet. Og så tager man på forskellige ture, som også koster en del

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Franskundervisning var billigere end forventet. Mad i supermarkederne var dyrere end forventet.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: fulgte fransk på universitetet uden at få merit, hvilket var fedt.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: De var mange muligheder, både sport, sprog mv.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Sprogundervisning - det er det eneste, jeg selv fulgte og dermed kan anbefale.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag rundt i landet på små ture. Det er det gode ved Frankrig, at der er gode togforbindelser til en billig pris.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var nemt nok, bortset fra på universitetet, hvor de har nogle mærkelige regler, som blot er til, fordi det er sådan, det er. Meget gammeldags.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Hæng ud i Cité Universitaire, der er en masse studerende.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: at franskmænd har sine principper, som blot er til for at blive håndhævet, dog uden større mening.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Folk er utroligt søde og har en god humor.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Hav tålmodighed, det er en oplevelse, nyd Paris og friheden

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Blevet bedre til fransk, har gode oplevelser og fået nogle gode relationer.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At blive testet på min tålmodighed angående det franske bureaukrati

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Nej

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
